transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I guess I’m here because things at work changed. My warehouse hours got switched around, and they put in this new inventory system, and I just… haven’t been handling it well.

I’ve been missing shifts, missing things at church. I snap at my family more than I should. Some mornings I’m sitting there with my work boots on and I just don’t know if I can make myself go in.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with family?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it that way. I still see my family and all. I guess I’ve just been more wrapped up in the work mess than anything.
Do you feel anxious or overwhelmed when thinking about the new inventory system or the changes at work?

Yeah… I do. When I think about that system, or the hours being all turned around, I just feel like I’m coming apart a bit.

It’s gotten bad enough I’ve missed shifts… and church things too. I get short with my family. Some mornings I’m sitting there with my boots on and I just… don’t know if I can make myself go in.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest in things you used to enjoy, like spending time with family or anything else that used to make you happy?
I’m not sure I’d call it losing interest. I still care about my family and all that. I guess I’ve just been… preoccupied, mostly. Hard to enjoy much when my mind keeps going back to work.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried even when you're not thinking about work or the changes there?

Mostly it comes back to work. The hours changing, that new system… that’s when I feel like I’m falling apart. I’ve missed shifts, missed church things, and I get short with my family. Some mornings I’m sitting there in my boots wondering if I can even face going in.
Outside of the stress with work, do you find yourself feeling down or losing pleasure in things most days?
I don’t know… not most days, I don’t think. It’s more when my mind gets on the work stuff. I still like being with my family, I’m just not always very present.
Do you find yourself feeling down or losing pleasure in things, even when you're not thinking about work or the changes there?

Not really on its own, no. It’s mostly when I get thinking about the warehouse… the changed hours, that new inventory system. That’s when I feel like I’m falling apart. I’ve been missing shifts, missing things at church, snapping at my family. Some mornings I’m just sitting there in my boots wondering if I can even go in.
Do you ever feel anxious or on edge about things outside of work, like during your time at home or when you’re with family?

Not so much outside of work. I mean, at home it comes out—I get short with my family—but it’s usually because I’m already wound up thinking about the warehouse, the hours, that new system. It all kind of follows me there.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried when you're doing routine things at home or when there’s no immediate stressor, like when you're watching TV or eating a meal with your family?

Not really if there’s nothing tied to work. I mean, I can be sitting with my family and still get wound up, but it’s because my mind goes back to those changed hours and that inventory system. That’s what started all this… missing shifts, church things, snapping at people. Some mornings I’m just sitting there in my boots, not sure I can face going in.
Can you recall any days in the past two weeks when you weren’t thinking about work at all, and if so, did you still feel down or lose pleasure in things on those days?

I can’t really think of a whole day where work wasn’t in my head at all. Since they changed the hours and put in that new inventory system, it’s like it just follows me. That’s when I get low or don’t want to do things… missing shifts, even church sometimes. It’s all tied to that, far as I can tell.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried for no clear reason, even when nothing stressful was happening around you?

No… not for no reason. It’s been since the warehouse changed my hours and put in that new system. That’s when I started feeling like I was coming apart a bit—missing shifts, missing church things, getting sharp with my family. Some mornings I’m just sitting there in my work boots, not sure I can face going in.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried when there wasn’t anything specific going on, like when you were resting or doing something you usually enjoy?

Not really out of nowhere. It’s… it comes back to the warehouse. Since they changed my hours and put in that inventory system, I feel like I’m falling apart some. Missing shifts, missing church commitments, snapping at my family. Some mornings I just sit there in my boots wondering if I can face going in.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried when there wasn’t anything specific bothering you, like when you were just relaxing or spending time with family without any problems happening?

Not really, no. It’s not like it comes out of nowhere. It’s been since they changed my hours at the warehouse and put in that inventory system. That’s when I started… not handling things right. Missing shifts, church stuff, snapping at home. Even getting my boots on some mornings, I just sit there wondering if I can go in.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried even during moments when everything around you was calm and nothing was bothering you, like when you were relaxing or enjoying time with family?

No… not when everything’s calm, not really. It’s tied to the warehouse. Since they changed my hours and put in that new inventory system, I’ve been… falling apart some. Missing shifts, church things, getting short with my family. Some mornings I’m just sitting there in my work boots wondering if I can face going in.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried when there wasn’t anything specific happening in your life, like when you were just sitting quietly by yourself or doing something you usually enjoy?

No… I don’t think so. It’s mostly been about the warehouse. Since the hours changed and they put that new inventory system in, I’ve just been… not keeping up. Missing shifts, missing church things, getting short with my family. Some mornings I sit there in my boots and don’t know if I can make myself go in.
